rationale.regulatory-compliance: Architects system specifically to comply with EU AI Act Article 14.
rationale.oversight-explanation: Presents complete multi-agent debate and reasoning to the human reviewer.
rationale.ai-review: Uses advocate and adversary agents to evaluate the candidate profile.
rationale.hitl-workflow: UI requires engagement with debate before enabling hiring decision buttons.
rationale.framework: Presents VARI as a reference architecture for compliance.
rationale.built-system: System is supplied by Thirty Seven Inc for deployment.
rationale.non-developer: Human overseers are recruiters and HR personnel, not developers.
rationale.general-ai: The AI system evaluates job candidates (employment AI), not code.
rationale.risk-bias: Adversary agent explicitly checks for and flags potential bias.
rationale.risk-overreliance: Mitigates automation bias by requiring review and tracking time-on-task.
